signals.signal: Refinancing with a fund or security agent
signals.why: Old security released and new security registered in favour of a security agent or fund, which often comes with a buyout or a private credit loan
signals.evidence: 3 new charges (Alter Domus Trustees (UK) Limited as Security Agent; Alter Domus Trustees (UK) Limited, as Security Agent; Palatine Private Equity LLP (The Security Trustee)), 1 released

signals.why: Several directors changed on one day; this often follows a sale, a refinancing or a group reorganisation
A lender registered security over the company, usually for a new loan or facility

_about: Signals are reasons to look, not proof. Names of individuals are left out.
